note: The hub NPC shops (engine/shop.js). A shop is a ROW: shopId (the server's shop id), npcId (a hubNpcs.json npc id; the shop opens when that NPC is tapped), title (the panel heading), stallLabel (the tag over the NPC) and radius (how close the player must be, in ground units; Marsh and Okafor stand about 8.5 apart). More stalls are more rows. Stock, names and prices come from the server (market_stock), cash and counts from its replies; this file holds only the rows, the layout of the tap target and the words. api.rpcPath plus calls.* name the Supabase rpc functions (docs/MARKET-CONTRACT.md); an answer that is not ok maps its error code through text.errors, anything unknown through text.errors.refused. inventorySlots is the length of the carried strip. hotspot sizes the invisible tap target over the NPC: heightUnits is how tall the body is in ground units, widthRatio the width as a share of the projected height, minPx the smallest side. enabled false or ?noshop=1 removes every shop. A guest (anonymous) account and an unreachable market both show the closed state.
